warnings: B8 is the ONLY detail on this sheet that prints four bar leaders instead of two — 2-DB16 / 2-DB12 / Stir Ø6@0.15 / 2-DB12 / 2-DB16, giving four bars on each face in two layers of mixed diameter. An earlier pass read it as the usual two-leader layout and recorded 2-DB12 top and bottom, losing four bars. Flagged by Makham 2026-08-26 and re-read at 8x. Because the two layers are different diameters they cannot be collapsed into one count, so main_bar carries the outer DB16 pairs, additional_bars the inner DB12 pairs, and bar_layers lists all four in order.

THIS SHEET CARRIES BEAM INFORMATION IN TWO PLACES and they must not be conflated. The top rows are single-cut boxes labelled 'DETAIL B1/B2/B3/B4/B7/B8'. B5 and B6 have NO detail box — they appear only as LONG SECTION B5 / LONG SECTION B6 with their own cuts, SECTION 1-1 (B5) in the middle right and SECTIONS 2-2 and 3-3 (B6) along the bottom. Makham could not find B5 on 2026-08-26 for exactly this reason; it is there, just in the long-section group.

B6 HAS TWO DIFFERENT CUTS, both 0.20x0.35 and both now recorded separately: SECTION 2-2 is the support zone (4 bars top = 2 + 2 'เสริมพิเศษ', 2 bottom, stirrups @0.10) and SECTION 3-3 is mid-span (2 top, 4 bottom = 2 + 2 'เสริมพิเศษ', stirrups @0.20). An earlier pass merged them into a single element and, in doing so, dropped both เสริมพิเศษ layers into notes instead of counting them — four bars lost. The zones are marked L/4 and L/5 from each support on LONG SECTION B6.
B5 and B6 were also recorded as 350x350. Both cuts print 0.20 x 0.35 — corrected to 200x350. No 350-wide beam exists on this sheet.

The other beam details were re-checked in the same pass and are as recorded: B1 2-DB12/2-DB12, B2 2-DB16/2-DB16, B3 2-DB12/2-DB12, B4 3-DB16/3-DB16 (Stir @0.15), B7 4-DB16 top with the 'ล้วงเข้าเสาหรือคาน ยาว 1.00 ม.' note / 2-DB16 bottom (Stir @0.10).
